program_solutions:
(rule!
  (paint-cells
    g
    (flatmap
      (lambda (obj)
        (let* ((bb (obj-bbox obj))
               (height (+ (- (third bb) (first bb)) 1))
               (width (+ (- (fourth bb) (second bb)) 1)))
          (if (and (= (obj-color obj) 2)
                   (= (obj-size obj) 3)
                   (= height 2)
                   (= width 2))
              (positions-in-rect (first bb) (second bb) (third bb) (fourth bb))
              (list))))
      (objects g 0))
    3))
